objective: Hold stable 50/50 synthetic cohorts with equivalent state and retry effects, then deliberately observe convergence to v2 without mistaking desired routing for observed migration.
preconditions: A modern local browser with JavaScript enabled; Node is required only for tests.
Invented v1 and v2 have fixed shared schema-1 accounts and idempotency keys.
Synthetic availability, identity, capacity and readiness are assumptions, not measured Azure properties.
actions: Hold 1-12 simulated 50/50 rounds with a chosen synthetic condition.
Inspect intended cohorts separately from observed destinations, state and effects.
Request 100% v2 convergence only after a passing observed split.
Record a separate convergence observation; inspect a lagging route or missing evidence.
Reset rehearsal to discard local evidence and start a separate attempt.

syntheticInput.transaction: Spend one synthetic credit for one ticket; retry the same operation key.
syntheticInput.round: One simulated minute, no wall-clock waiting

expectedAssertions: Configured 50% or 100% is never counted as an observation.
A held stable experiment has ten observed users on each version, not complete migration.
Compatible versions preserve schema, cumulative state and one effect per transaction despite retries.
Unstable assignment and incompatible state/effects produce failed user-impact outcomes.
Missing observations produce unknown outcomes without fabricated state.
Prior failed/unknown rounds survive later passing samples.
Only a new complete compatible convergence sample can pass for all twenty fixture users.
Invalid inputs preserve the current rehearsal and explain the rejection.

iac.reason: Resource-free local HTML/JS/CSS training bundle. Explicitly recorded after behavioral red and before implementation.

scope.testRuntime: Node.js 22.23.4 is test tooling, not production runtime validation.
